integration_expectations.builder_tip_protocol: Commit only .planning/phases/06-wp-3-verify-cli-and-ci-surface/06-PROMOTION-REQUEST.json on metadata_parent; that request-only commit is builder_tip and the request does not name it.
integration_expectations.ci_query: Require one authenticated exact-SHA wayland-nano-gate run for pushed origin/master with exactly the six literal required_jobs completed/success.
integration_expectations.integration_gate: In a detached F: integration worktree, merge --no-ff with parent 1 equal freshly fetched origin/master and parent 2 equal builder_tip, then run F-only just gate-all.
integration_expectations.master_tip: Push detached integration HEAD:master, fetch origin, and require origin/master equals the integration commit.
integration_expectations.merge_parents: Require integration parent 1 equals pre-merge origin/master and parent 2 equals builder_tip.
integration_expectations.request_only_diff: Require git diff --name-only metadata_parent..builder_tip equals only .planning/phases/06-wp-3-verify-cli-and-ci-surface/06-PROMOTION-REQUEST.json.
